tasks.label: Dev: Ocean
tasks.command: for p in $(grep -l 'DOWNDRAFT_GAME=to-the-ocean' /proc/*/environ 2>/dev/null | cut -d/ -f3; pgrep -f "user-data-dir=[^ ]*downdraft-to-the-ocean" 2>/dev/null); do [ "$p" = "$$" ] && continue; pgid=$(awk '/^(NSpgid|PGid):/{print $2}' /proc/$p/status 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$pgid" ] && kill -TERM -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 1; for p in $(grep -l 'DOWNDRAFT_GAME=to-the-ocean' /proc/*/environ 2>/dev/null | cut -d/ -f3; pgrep -f "user-data-dir=[^ ]*downdraft-to-the-ocean" 2>/dev/null); do [ "$p" = "$$" ] && continue; pgid=$(awk '/^(NSpgid|PGid):/{print $2}' /proc/$p/status 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$pgid" ] && kill -9 -"$pgid" 2>/dev/null; done; npx electron-vite dev --config games/to-the-ocean/electron.vite.config.ts

tasks.label: Build: Game(s)
tasks.detail: Pick game(s) + target platform(s), then build + package each with electron-builder
tasks.command: set -e; WIN=""; LINUX=""; MAC=""; for pt in ${input:platforms}; do p="${pt%%:*}"; t="${pt#*:}"; case "$p" in win) WIN="$WIN $t";; linux) LINUX="$LINUX $t";; mac) MAC="$MAC $t";; esac; done; EB_ARGS=""; [ -n "$WIN" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --win$WIN"; [ -n "$LINUX" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --linux$LINUX"; [ -n "$MAC" ] && EB_ARGS="$EB_ARGS --mac$MAC"; echo "[Build] Target platforms:$EB_ARGS"; FAIL=0; for G in ${input:game}; do GAME_PKG="games/$G/package.json"; PRODUCT_NAME=$(node -e "const p=require('./'+process.argv[1]); console.log(p.productName || p.build?.productName || String(p.name).replace(/-/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase()))" "$GAME_PKG"); APP_ID=$(node -e "const p=require('./'+process.argv[1]); console.log(p.build?.appId || 'com.downdraft.'+process.argv[2])" "$GAME_PKG" "$G"); echo ""; echo "[Build] Game: $G | Product: \"$PRODUCT_NAME\" | AppId: $APP_ID"; echo "[Build] Building $G with Vite..."; npx electron-vite build --config "games/$G/electron.vite.config.ts" || { echo "[Build] Vite build failed for $G — skipping"; FAIL=1; continue; }; echo "[Build] Packaging $G with electron-builder ($EB_ARGS)..."; npx electron-builder -c.productName="$PRODUCT_NAME" -c.appId="$APP_ID" -c.extraMetadata.name="$G" $EB_ARGS || { echo "[Build] electron-builder failed for $G — skipping"; FAIL=1; continue; }; echo "[Build] $G done."; done; echo ""; if [ "$FAIL" = "1" ]; then echo '[Build] One or more games failed — see output above.'; fi; echo '[Build] All selected games processed. Opening release folder...'; OPENER=xdg-open; command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1 || OPENER=open; $OPENER "${workspaceFolder}/release"

args.command: printf '%s\n' 'win:portable|Windows Portable|Single .exe, no install needed' 'win:nsis|Windows Installer|NSIS .exe installer' 'mac:dmg|macOS DMG|Disk image installer' 'mac:zip|macOS Zip|Zipped app bundle' 'linux:AppImage|Linux AppImage|Portable single-file executable' 'linux:deb|Linux .deb|Debian/Ubuntu package' 'linux:rpm|Linux .rpm|Fedora/RHEL package' 'linux:flatpak|Linux Flatpak|Sandboxed Flathub package'
